components.name: Electronic Control Unit (ECU)

components.name: Heat Exchanger or Cooling System

components.name: Mounting Structure

components.name: Winding Insulation Material
components.reasoning: The insulation material protects windings from electromagnetic interference and physical damage, often procured separately even though it's integrated into the stator during production.

components.name: Permanent Magnets (for PMSM)
components.reasoning: For PMSMs, these magnets are a critical component with varying material types like neodymium or samarium-cobalt and manufactured as separate units.

components.name: Commutator (for AC induction motors)
components.reasoning: In some lower-performance models, a commutator converts the alternating current into direct current but may be integrated directly with the motor in higher-efficiency designs.

components.name: Power Diodes and Connectors
components.reasoning: For both AC induction and PMSM motors, power diodes manage current direction while connectors provide electrical interface points, typically sourced separately.

components.name: Housing Enclosure
components.reasoning: The motor casing provides structural protection and integration into vehicle designs; though integrated with the motor in some cases, it’s often treated as a separate component for procurement purposes.

components.name: Cabling & Connectors

components.name: Lubrication System
